purpose: Final evidence query before handoff. The ancestor record for interface15 shows the selected support [4,14,15] with terminal elements C,C,N and a same-forward teacher predicted endpoint, but it does not show whether this local support is enriched by selection or how the current controller responds to it. Querying selection_trend and controller_response for the same region distinguishes (a) a support that is genuinely enriched by selection from (b) a support whose apparent success is only initial-state similarity, and separates native generation change from selection-expectation change and random replication change. This is needed to decide whether interface15 is a defensible principal intervention or whether the smaller 2-point supports (interface16/17/19) or interface22 should be preferred. No affinity derivative, SMC, or chemistry module is assumed; only element/geometry proxies are used.
